name: Tunnel crawl
kicker: Wartime tunnel network, two separate gates
summary: A wartime tunnel network: crawl the widened section on a day from the city, for the earth around you. The visitor section is about 120 meters on two levels, and the rest of the day is the walk above ground. Bến Dược and Bến Đình are separate gates. Skip the day if you need one ticket and one address for both.
getThere: About 1 hour to Bến Dược, or about 70 km
heroCaption: A tunnel entrance, the lid set in the leaves

notice.title: Name the gate
notice.body: Bến Dược and Bến Đình are separate grounds. From 1 Feb 2026 a foreign visitor pays 35,000 đồng for the historical site and 100,000 đồng for the guide. Those two lines stay separate.

body: You drop through a lid in the leaves, or you come to a round mouth in a mound of earth, and the bore stays tight. A widened visitor section runs about 120 meters on two levels. That length is the crawl. The wartime network runs longer than 200 km, with about 500 km of trenches on the surface. Most of the visit is the walk above ground.

Bến Dược is the regional command ground at ấp Phú Hiệp, xã An Nhơn Tây. Keep the older address line too: Phu Hiep Hamlet, Phu My Hung Commune, Cu Chi District. Bến Đình is the district-committee base at ấp Bến Đình, xã Nhuận Đức, on Provincial Road 15. The address 87A Trần Kế Xương in Phú Nhuận is a 1955–1958 liaison office, off these grounds.

From 1 Feb 2026 a foreign visitor pays 35,000 đồng for the historical site and 100,000 đồng for the guide. The guide line had been 90,000 đồng. The levels sit about 3 m, 6 m, and 12 m or deeper. The gate runs 7:00–17:00, including Saturday, Sunday, and Tết. After 17:00 the grounds are quiet except on a Trăng chiến khu night, which is its own ticket.

figures.caption: A round tunnel mouth in a mound of earth
figures.alt: A round earthen tunnel mouth beside a path, with the bore in the frame

gettingThere: Name the gate before you leave the city. The road to Bến Dược takes about one hour from the city centre. The tunnels are also placed at about 70 km northwest, with Provincial Road 15 and Phú Hiệp in the same line.

legs.heading: From the city centre
legs.body: By road, about one hour to Bến Dược. The same journey is also placed at about 70 km, with the gates unsplit. A taxi is quoted at 600,000–700,000 đồng a trip, with no gate on the quote. Self-drive follows Trường Chinh, ngã tư An Sương, Hóc Môn, then Provincial Road 15.

legs.heading: By bus to Bến Dược
legs.body: Bus 13 from Bến Thành, or 94 from Chợ Lớn, to the Củ Chi bus station, then 79 to Bến Dược. Route 79 is also called Củ Chi – Dầu Tiếng.

legs.heading: By bus to Bến Đình
legs.body: Bus 13 or 94 to An Sương, 122 to Tân Quy, then 70 to Bến Đình. This is the other gate, on Provincial Road 15.

closed: No weekly closing day. The gate includes Saturday, Sunday, and Tết. After 17:00 the grounds are quiet except on a Trăng chiến khu night.
admissionNote: Foreign visitors, from 1 Feb 2026: historical-site admission 35,000 đồng a person a visit, and a service-and-guide ticket 100,000 đồng a person a visit. The two lines stay separate. The guide ticket had been 90,000 đồng. A Vietnamese adult price, child bands, and a price only for Bến Đình: Check on arrival. The liberated zone is 65,000 đồng a person. Shooting, boats, and paintball: Check on arrival.
